claims: The Artemis II mission is scheduled to splash down on Friday, April 10, 2026, at approximately 5:07 p.m. PDT (8:07 p.m. EDT).
The Orion capsule carrying four astronauts will land in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
Recovery operations will be conducted by the USS John P. Murtha.
Live coverage begins on NASA+ and YouTube at 3:30 p.m. PDT / 6:30 p.m. EDT.
Re-entry will involve a communication blackout during peak heating before parachutes deploy to bring the crew safely to the water.
